snippet.title: Sente | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1005180/Sente/

Join the Discord: https://discord.com/invite/KJuBAsb

Welcome to the world of Sente, where AI robots have taken over as the dominant species on the planet and created their own intellectual sport; Sente.

It’s up to you, a human posing as a robot, to infiltrate their space and beat them at their own game through a myriad of puzzles and increasingly sophisticated rivals to prove that humanity can still compete.
